lmsHighlights.title: Role-Based Hierarchy
lmsHighlights.description: Super Admin, Admin, Learner – clean, scoped roles. Admins vary in power but use one label for simplicity and clarity.

lmsHighlights.title: Delegated Power
lmsHighlights.description: Super Admins don't create users. Designed for smart delegation — not micromanagement.

lmsHighlights.title: Real-Time Code Compiler
lmsHighlights.description: Integrated Judge0 API to support multiple programming languages and allow learners to write, compile, and execute code in real-time.

lmsHighlights.title: Colleges & Departments
lmsHighlights.description: Supports multiple colleges and departments with a clean structure for navigation and assignment control.

lmsHighlights.title: Dynamic Batch System
lmsHighlights.description: Group students from different departments into batches for specialized training programs or short-term courses.

lmsHighlights.title: Smart Assessments
lmsHighlights.description: Admin-level test assignment flexibility: by department, batch, or individual student. Precision targeting for evaluations.

lmsHighlights.title: Academic Tracking
lmsHighlights.description: Training and assessments are linked to auto-generate detailed academic reports.

lmsHighlights.title: Activity Visibility
lmsHighlights.description: Track logins, failed attempts, tests taken — no student activity goes unnoticed.

lmsHighlights.title: Custom Dashboards
lmsHighlights.description: Widget-based dashboards tailored to user roles. Add, remove, or reorder components as needed.

lmsHighlights.title: Visual Reports
lmsHighlights.description: Academic data visualized through charts and tables. Exportable for external analytics or audits.

lmsHighlights.title: Bulk Communication
lmsHighlights.description: Send announcements and notifications at scale to learners and admins. Keeps everyone in sync.
